status: WORKING NON-CANON; regional mathematical verification, not geological acceptance
scope: W02 1D regional constant-density shared-velocity kinematics, material history, conservative remap and declared ownership/boundary events

equations.reconstruction: H_k(x)=H_ki+s_ki*(x-x_ci), positivity-limited on each donor interval
equations.markers: piecewise-affine material map; accumulated strain += log(new_width/old_width)

boundary_contract: Mesh and physical velocity are independent inputs; closed means u-w=0.
Open relative inflow requires named exterior cohort composition and reservoir.
Regridding preserves time, frame and full domain extent; no implicit crop/fill.
MUSCL outgoing Courant bound 0.5 is checked at initial and final geometry.
Crossed or numerically unresolved cells and known events inside an interval are refused.
Mean SSP-stage fluxes reconcile whole-domain and neighbouring block accounts.
state_contract: Cohort origin/formation time survives remaps and plate/block membership changes.
A shared ordered cut belongs to both neighbours; intervals cover the entire model domain once.
Splits/merges retain reserved retired IDs and explicit parent lineage; IDs are not recycled.
Events require current model parent and unused event ID; candidate failure never mutates accepted state.
Instantaneous ownership reclassification is not material displacement.
Markers locate material under an explicit material map; they are not mass-carrying parcels.
Snapshots are self-contained for restoration; prior receipts remain independent history records to retain when required.
Coarsening can lose spatial information despite conservation; inverse remapping is not promised.
deferred_claims: variable density, momentum or energy conservation
predictive crust-production, accretion or subduction rates

sources.scope: Fazio and LeVeque moving-mesh conservation; conceptual method reference, not copied implementation
Geometric conservation law; primary methods reference
